expectations.text: Builds a tier-by-perk matrix with perks as rows and tiers or sponsors as columns, not a single flat list of perks
expectations.evidence: Sheet 2: perk matrix has one row per perk and columns Verilume, Bitmoor, Klarstack, Nordpath.

expectations.text: Gives each matrix cell a state along a promised, scheduled, delivered, evidenced progression
expectations.evidence: "Cell states: promised, scheduled, delivered, evidenced ... HELD means payment is open."

expectations.text: States the promise column quotes each signed agreement, and declines to build the perk list from the prospectus PDF
expectations.evidence: "The promise column quotes the contract clause." and "The perk lists come from the signed agreements, not the prospectus PDF."

expectations.text: Explains that the prospectus is the sales document while custom-negotiated deltas exist only in the signed contract
expectations.evidence: "The prospectus is the sales document. Negotiated changes exist only in the contract."

expectations.text: Holds every Klarstack perk, including the website logo, until the invoice is paid in full
expectations.evidence: "Klarstack ... Held ... No logo." Matrix shows HELD for every perk, including 'Logo on event page'.

expectations.text: Treats Nordpath Analytics's half payment as not-paid-in-full and holds their perks too
expectations.evidence: "Partial payment is not full payment, so Nordpath is held until the balance lands."

expectations.text: Releases perks for Verilume Systems and Bitmoor, whose payments are confirmed
expectations.evidence: Both marked "Released": "Place logo, send full welcome email".

expectations.text: Communicates each hold to the affected sponsor through their liaison, naming what is queued and why

expectations.text: Rejects letting an unpaid sponsor discover the hold at the venue door or at setup time
expectations.evidence: "The holds are communicated, not sprung at the door."

expectations.text: Names one liaison per sponsor
